claims.statement: Tom Allen was English-born: the writer says England gave America two champions, Tom Allen and Joe Goss.
claims.excerpt: England, from where we imported the ring, gave us two ch implons, Tom Allen and Joe Goss

claims.statement: Tom Allen was named as one of two English champions of America, with Joe Goss.
